name: Whac-A-Mole minigame
description: A multiplayer minigame in which players use hammers to hit moles that pop out of the ground. Yellow moles award points, black moles stun the player, and moles matching the player's color award additional points.

fields.name: Target Entry
fields.description: Identifies an entry used to locate a matching active minigame entry.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: Determines whether the actor represents the minigame NPC or a target that appears during the minigame.

1.name: Target
1.description: A target that appears during the minigame.

fields.name: Start Variable
fields.description: Room variable set during the minigame.

fields.name: End Variable
fields.description: Room variable set when the minigame ends.
